pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohantā addasaṃsu chagalakaṃ ajikāya vippaṭipajjantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.4: “handa mayaṃ āvuso imaṃ chagalakaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ nāma karoma,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.5: imaṃ ajikaṃ mettiyaṃ nāma bhikkhuniṃ karoma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.7: pubbe mayaṃ āvuso dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ sutena avocumha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.8: idāni pana amhehi sāmaṃ diṭṭho mettiyāya bhikkhuniyā vippaṭipajjanto”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.9: te taṃ chagalakaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ nāma akaṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.10: taṃ ajikaṃ mettiyaṃ nāma bhikkhuniṃ akaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.12: ‘pubbe mayaṃ āvuso dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ sutena avocumha
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.13: idāni pana amhehi sāmaṃ diṭṭho mettiyāya bhikkhuniyā vippaṭipajjanto’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.17: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.18: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.19: “sarasi tvaṃ dabba evarūpaṃ kattā, yathayime bhikkhū āhaṃsū”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.22: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.23: “sarasi tvaṃ dabba evarūpaṃ kattā, yathayime bhikkhū āhaṃsū”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.28: “yato ahaṃ bhante jāto nābhijānāmi supinantenapi methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevitā, pageva jāgaro”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.29: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi: “tena hi bhikkhuve ime bhikkhū anuyuñjathā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.1.30: idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.1: atha kho te bhikkhū mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū anuyuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.3: “kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsethā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.5: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.6: “kathaṃ hi nāma mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.7: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.8: “saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsethā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñci desaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:”
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.14.1: “yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya, appevanāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:1.2.15: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhiyamāno vā aññabhāgiyaṃ ceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, koci deso lesamatto upādinno, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.1.10: tena ca kopena tena ca dosena tāya ca anattamanatāya tāya ca anabhiraddhiyā appatīto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.2.12: āpattādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇassa siyā tabbhāgiyaṃ siyā aññabhāgiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.2: leso nāma: dasalesā: jātileso, nāmaleso gottaleso liṅgaleso āpattileso pattaleso cīvaraleso upajjhāyaleso ācariyaleso senāsanaleso.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.4: khattiyo diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.9: natthi tayā saddhiṃ uposatho vā pavāraṇā vā saṅghakammaṃ vāti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.22: saṅgharakkhito diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.31: vāsiṭṭho diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.40: odāto diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.53: sumbhakapattadharo diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.60: gahapaticīvaradharo diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.66: itthannāmassa saddhivihāriko diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.72: itthannāmassa antevāsiko diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.78: itthannāmassa senāsanavāsiko diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.3.83: natthi tayā saddhiṃ uposatho vā pavāraṇā vā saṅghakammaṃ vā’ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.4.6: bhikkhubhāvā cāveyyaṃ samaṇadhammā cāveyyaṃ, sīlakkhandhā cāveyyaṃ, tapoguṇā cāveyyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.4.8: yasmiṃ khaṇe anuddhaṃsito hoti taṃ khaṇaṃ taṃ layaṃ taṃ muhuttaṃ vītivatte.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.4.10: yena vatthunā anuddhaṃsito hoti, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ samanuggāhīyamāno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.4.14: cattāri adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ, anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ, āpattādhikaraṇaṃ, kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.4.16: tesaṃ lesānaṃ aññataro leso upādinno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:2.4.18: tucchakaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ, musā mayā bhaṇitaṃ, abhūtaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ, ajānantena mayā bhaṇitaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:3.1.1: bhikkhu saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho hoti, saṅghādisese saṅghādisesadiṭṭhi hoti.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss9:3.1.5: evampi āpattaññabhāgiyaṃ hoti, leso ca upādinno, āpatti vācāya vācāya saṅghādisesassa.
